verdict.rationale: The evidence describes individual Graph API calls (single channel message send, single team/channel creation, export APIs) and CLI commands for single agent/app packaging, but nothing documents bulk or batch operations across many items at once (e.g., batch message send, bulk channel creation, bulk data export in one call). Missing for 10: batch API support, bulk create/update endpoints, CLI bulk commands, or any documented example of operating on multiple items simultaneously.
